title: Implement no-drops safety validation
description: Implement safety validation to ensure generated DDL never drops or alters existing database objects without explicit user action.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated DDL contains no DROP statements
Generated DDL contains no ALTER statements that modify existing objects
Only CREATE statements are generated for new objects

evidence: Commit 49b8555 on ticket/TASK-045: TASK-045: implement DDL no-drops safety validation

New file: backend/src/services/ddl-safety-validator.ts — validateDDLSafety() rejects DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE and any ALTER that is not ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT; only CREATE and ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT permitted

New file: backend/src/services/ddl-safety-validator.test.ts — 23 unit tests covering CREATE TABLE, CREATE INDEX, ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT (PK/FK/UNIQUE), DROP TABLE/COLUMN/CONSTRAINT/INDEX, TRUNCATE, DELETE, ALTER COLUMN/RENAME/ADD COLUMN, case-insensitive matching, mixed scripts, error reporting
Modified: backend/src/routes/apply-schema.ts — validateDDLSafety() called before connecting (fail fast); invalid DDL returns 400 with details and no DB connection; inline DROP/TRUNCATE guard replaced

Modified: backend/src/routes/apply-schema.test.ts — updated DROP rejection test for fail-fast (no connection attempted); added tests for ALTER modification rejection, TRUNCATE rejection, DELETE rejection, and ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT allowance
